sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 485 was established by Ordinance No. 23278, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1997. Ordinance No. 23278 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 23278 was amended by Ordinance No. 25705, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 25, 2004. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23278; 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 485 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of LBJ Freeway (IH 635) and Hillcrest Road. The size of PD 485 is approximately 3.5772 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23278; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article, ASSISTED LIVING FACILITY means a permanent residential facility which furnishes (in single or multiple facilities) food, shelter, laundry and other assistance in activities of daily living to five or more persons who are not related by blood, marriage, or adoption to the owner or proprietor of the establishment. Food is prepared in a central kitchen. Individual dwelling units do not have kitchen facilities (i.e. do not have cook tops, ranges, or full size appliances, but may contain bar sinks, small refrigerators, or microwave ovens). Assisted living facilities must be licensed as Personal Care Facilities under Chapter 247 of the Texas Health and Safety Code. Assisted living facilities do not include other licensed health facilities under Subtitle B, "Licensing of Health Facilities," of Title 4, "Health Facilities," of the Texas Health and Safety Code, specifically nursing homes.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.104. DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) For an assisted living facility, development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 485A).

(b) For all other permitted uses, Sections 4.702(c)(2) through (i), regarding submission of or amendments to a conceptual plan, development plan, site analysis plan, development schedule, or landscape plan, do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided below, the main uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the R-1/2ac(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-1/2ac(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the R-

1/2ac(A) Single Family District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-1/2ac(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc.

(b) Assisted living facility. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory community service center. -- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Except for the assisted living facility, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R- 1/2ac(A) Single Family District contained in Section 51A-4.112(b)(4) apply to property located in this PD.

(b) The yard, lot, and space regulations for an assisted living facility are as follows:

(1) Front, side, and rear yard. Front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) Dwelling units. Maximum number of dwelling units or suites is 77.

(3) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 58,500 square feet.

(4) Height. Maximum structure height is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(7) Stories. Maximum number of stories is three. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking for an assisted living facility must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. Consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for all other uses. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.110. LIGHTING.

(a) Detached lighting must be indirect, diffused, or covered by shielded-type fixtures and be installed on standards at a maximum height of 10 feet above grade.

(b) The intensity of spillover light on neighboring residential lots, measured at a point five feet inside the residential lot line and five feet above the ground, may not exceed 0.1 foot-candle. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Subject to the provisions of Section 51P-485.112, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) Tree mitigation and preservation must comply with Article X.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Tree Mitigation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.112. TREE MITIGATION.

(a) Tree protection, removal, and replacement must comply with Article X.

(b) The following regulations apply to any protected tree that remains on the “Tree Protection and Removal Plan” (Exhibit 485B).

(1) If the removal is a result of the reason described in Section 51A-10.101(23) or Section 51A-10.136(c), the tree replacement requirements of Article X apply and at least one replacement tree must be a minimum of five caliper inches.

(2) In all cases (e.g., where a tree dies of natural causes) each removed tree shall be replaced with another tree measuring at least five caliper inches.

(3) A minimum of one replacement tree measuring at least five caliper inches must be planted in the same approximate location as the tree removed, unless otherwise specified by the city arborist.

(c) All replacement trees must be chosen from the city’s approved replacement tree list, as defined in Section 51A-10.134. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.114. FENCING.

Fencing may not exceed eight feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 25705; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.116. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23278; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23278; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-485.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 485 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. Nos. 23278; 26042)
